description: Use this when the user wants mobile data in Japan on an eSIM: which travel eSIM covers a trip of a given length, unlimited data versus 3GB per day, what it costs, or a monthly eSIM (data only, or with a phone number) for living in Japan longer than 90 days. Returns plans with data allowance, validity, the tax-included price in JPY and the order page. Read-only. Do not use it for physical SIM cards, pocket Wi-Fi rental, roaming in other countries, or phone repair; for whether a phone supports eSIM, point the user to the compatibility page in the result.

data.description: Travel eSIM only: unlimited data, 3GB per day, or any. Default any.

days.description: Number of days the user will be in Japan and needs data. Trips longer than 90 days return monthly plans.

locale.description: Language for product names and page links (en, ja, ko, zh = Simplified Chinese, tw = Traditional Chinese, es, fr, de, it, th, id, vi). Default en.

stay_type.description: travel = short trip (up to 90 days); monthly = living in Japan, renewed every month. Default: travel when days is 90 or less, otherwise monthly.

name: search_esim_plans

compatibility_url.description: Page that explains which phones support eSIM.

error.description: Present only when the call failed; a short reason the user can act on.

plan_days.description: Travel eSIM: length of the smallest plan that covers the trip.

area.description: Area in Japan the service covers, or null when it applies nationwide.

booking_method.description: online_checkout = pay on the page; online_request = submit the form, OlaChill confirms by email before any payment; quote_request = send the details and OlaChill replies with a price.

booking_status.description: bookable_online = a fixed price can be paid on the page when booking; on_request = OlaChill checks first and nothing is charged when the request is sent.

id.description: Stable OlaChill id for this course, package, vehicle option or plan.

price.description: Price in the stated currency; null when no reliable price is published.

unit.description: What the price covers, e.g. per_person, per_vehicle_per_day, per_vehicle_hours, per_esim, per_month.

price_basis.description: What the price covers and how firm it is (fixed, from, class-tier estimate, reference or no published price).

url.description: Page on olachill.com where the traveller books or sends the request.

validity_days.description: Days the plan runs; null for monthly plans that renew each month.

title: Find a Japan eSIM plan
